goal: Add type validation and stricter error checking for command-line arguments and configuration settings
Prevent coercion bugs such as negated options parsing as strings and catch duplicate configuration keys
reviewability: Review may wait for a response because the author has been inactive for 176 days
Author has suggested reviewing #31260 first to explore C++ types instead of bit flags
agreement: Objection: treating empty values as resetting to defaults alters config semantics, answered (ajtowns)
Objections on flag combinations and fuzz exception handling were addressed (maflcko, l0rinc)
Broad support for incremental type validation and error checking (hodlinator, hebasto, laanwj, promag)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it provides typed argument validation to prevent subtle configuration coercion bugs
Directly unblocks five follow-up PRs to convert production arguments to typed flags
Immediate impact is limited because existing production arguments are not yet converted
